description:
Activate Carnage Interpreter by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Carnage Interpreter enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Carnage Interpreter trigger, causing you to discard your hand, and then create four Clue, four Food and four Treasure tokens due to Academy Manufactor.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Carnage Interpreter.
Activate two Treasure by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.
